sanctionedExceptions.description: During the Stage 12B corrective closure, a semantic panel-content leakage review (Section 11 of the corrective-closure audit) found that content.note text on two Pilot 1/2 panels embedded author/debrief-level interpretive conclusions (e.g. Pilot 1's panel-calibration: 'does not itself explain a shift...') that leaked the learner's intended conclusion. A subsequent FINAL UI INTEGRATION / LEAKAGE closure found the same issue on two further Pilot 3 panels (panel-eqa's 'IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION LIMIT... does NOT... prove no analytical issue exists'; panel-specimen-context's 'does not exhaustively rule out'/'supportive, not decisive'). Per the audit's explicit instruction each time ('STOP and report the precise case-data/interface issue before modifying it... a narrowly justified learner-facing projection field may be proposed if genuinely necessary, but Stage 12A case modifications require explicit listing in the final report'), this was documented and a narrow, additive fix applied both times: an OPTIONAL content.learnerNote field (the purely-factual projection) was added to case-schema.js's documentation and to the affected panels. content.note itself was NEVER altered or removed anywhere — it remains the full authored text for audit/debrief purposes. A subsequent FINAL INTERVENTION-SEMANTICS ACCEPTANCE closure found that generic bare-dispatched APPLY_INTERVENTION could receive full positive credit in Pilots 2/3 despite no case-authored evidentiary backing existing for either case; per that audit's EXPLICIT instruction (Section 3: 'Add a case-authored Pilot 1 intervention decision... Use the existing decision machinery... Do not create a new engine rule'), a new decisionOpportunity (dec-intervention/opt-revert-lot, category INTERVENTION, actionType APPLY_INTERVENTION, requiredEvidenceIdsForSupportedReasoning:['ev-old-lot-repeat']) was added to pilot-1-reagent-lot-shift.js — using ONLY the existing, unmodified Stage 12A decision-authoring machinery (the same authoredOption/requiredEvidenceIdsForSupportedReasoning mechanism dec-containment and dec-disposition already use); zero engine.js/decision-model.js changes were needed or made. Pilots 2 and 3 received NO new decision (neither has a scientifically justified analytical intervention) — the absence of a generic 'Apply intervention' control for those two cases follows generically from decision non-availability, not from a case-ID check. These four files (case-schema.js plus all three pilot case files) are the ONLY sanctioned exceptions to the Stage 12A freeze; all other files in this manifest, and all Stage 12A engine logic/behavior, remain completely unchanged.
